svg.title: Spectre Brands xl10 Bubble Graffiti (clean)
svg.desc: Graffiti bubble-marker lettering (cream fill, fat black outline, offset shadow) signed off with a tiny ghost tag. VHS shell darkgrey, orange rental label #E8641A at -3 degrees, lettering Sedgwick Ave bubble letters: cream fill, black outline, drop shadow, outlined paths. clean version.
